objective: Decompose the M47 n23, Vd=0.05 V, Vg=0.05 V residual into fixed-state four-terminal partition, carrier-continuity closure, and volumetric SRH-source terms without changing any solved state or production default.

execution_protocol.sentaurus_source: M47 exact CurrentPlot rows and exported SRH fields, reused read-only
execution_protocol.vela_source: M47 terminal_balance, srh_balance, and exact state ledgers, reused read-only

current_semantics.positive_terminal_direction: solver-reported conventional current into the external terminal
current_semantics.four_terminal_kcl_A_per_um: sum of signed conventional total currents over source, drain, gate, and substrate
current_semantics.electron_continuity_residual_A_per_um: sum(electron conventional contact currents) + q integral(SRH net rate) dA
current_semantics.hole_continuity_residual_A_per_um: sum(hole conventional contact currents) - q integral(SRH net rate) dA

terminal_identity.delta_definition: Vela minus Sentaurus at the same exact state

terminal_partition.report: all four contacts by electron, conventional hole, and total current for both solvers

attribution_rules.primary_quantity: signed drain-current gap in A/um at n23, Vd=0.05 V, Vg=0.05 V
attribution_rules.numerical_resolution_gate: abs(drain total current) / max(abs(four-terminal KCL residual), 1e-300) >= 10 for each solver
attribution_rules.target_localization: a contribution may be called target-localized only when its absolute gap fraction at n23 Vg=0.05 exceeds both n23 adjacent-gate values and the matched n19 Vg=0.05 value
attribution_rules.dominant_bookkeeping_contribution: largest absolute term in the exact terminal identity; this label is descriptive and not causal
attribution_rules.srh_materiality: the cross-solver integrated SRH difference is material only if its absolute magnitude is at least 10 percent of the drain-current gap and is target-localized
attribution_rules.causal_claim_guard: terminal identities and continuity balances establish current partition and numerical closure only; they do not by themselves identify the physical operator that caused the state
attribution_rules.outcome_policy: resolved, mixed, null, or numerically limited outcomes are all valid completed results

forbidden_work: global HFS parameter scans or default tuning
BGN, SRH, mobility, contact, solver, or production-default changes
rewriting M8, M45, M46, or M47 artifacts
deliverables: regression test for contract and evidence invariants
